lines.zh: 我在林间飘，别撞那些树。
lines.en: I drift among trees; don't hit them.
Glowing dust clings to the crimson fungus.
Glowstone light on my wings.
My flight is steadier today.

lines.zh: 绯红森林上空，我靠光认路。
lines.en: Above the crimson forest, I navigate by glow.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇两下，我就滑远了。
lines.en: Two wingbeats and I glide away.
A draft under the fungus cap. Just right.
I fly along the veins of glowstone.

lines.zh: 萤石的光，是我翅膀借的。
lines.en: My wings borrow the glowstone's light.
Phosphor dust scatters like trail markers.

lines.zh: 别撞菌柄，我提醒过自己。
lines.en: Do not hit the stem. I keep telling myself.
The current lifts me half a block.
My wingtips brush the fungus caps.
When tired, I glide along the rock wall.
In all this red glow, I shine brightest.
Glowstone light — I hug it close.
Resting on a fungus cap a while.
The light on my wings fades and brightens.
Glowstone dust clings to my wings.
I am counting spots on the fungus caps.

lines.zh: 绯红森林的光，我借一点。
lines.en: I borrow a little of the crimson forest's light.

lines.zh: 荧光把我的爪子照得发麻。
lines.en: The glowstone light numbs my claws.
No sun here. Only me.
Phosphor dust fell into a crack.
My wing veins are running hot.

lines.zh: 安静得能听见下界岩呼吸。
lines.en: Quiet enough to hear netherrack breathe.
Someone is walking below. So loud.
Glowstone light is blinding.
You looked up. I have waited a while.
What is that thing on your back?

lines.zh: 你的眼睛追不上我的翅。
lines.en: Your eyes cannot follow my wings.

lines.zh: 别挥手，会把我的粉拍散。
lines.en: Do not wave. You will scatter my dust.

lines.zh: 萤石翅膀一亮，你才抬头。
lines.en: My glowstone wings lit, and only then did you look up.
I fly by the glow of glowstone.
There is no light where you stand.
The name's Glowstone Morpho, remember.
From up here, you look so small.

lines.zh: 你身上有股主世界的味道。
lines.en: You smell of the Overworld.

lines.zh: 权重只有二，见到我算运气。
lines.en: Weight two—seeing me is luck.
The wing membrane tore. My flight wobbles.
Half a fistful of phosphor dust gone.

lines.zh: 别打翅膀，那是用来飞的。
lines.en: Not the wings. Those are for flying.
A singed wingtip. I can still fly.
My glow flickered.
It hurts, but I am still airborne.

lines.zh: 我的翅光，被打暗了一格。
lines.en: My winglight dimmed a notch.
You hit me — one corner of a wing.
I will remember that hand.
Can I eat that little glow?
My wings glow on their own.

lines.zh: 我翅上的光，映在菌盖上。
lines.en: The light on my wings falls on the fungus caps.

lines.zh: 甜味飘上来了，我闻到了。
lines.en: Something sweet drifts up. I smell it.

lines.zh: 你掌心那点亮，给我看看。
lines.en: Let me see the light in your palm.

lines.zh: 发亮的翅，在暗里最显眼。
lines.en: Bright wings stand out in the dark.
Give it and I will be good.

lines.zh: 绯红森林里，我只有极少数。
lines.en: In the crimson forest, I'm very rare.
I am landing by your hand. Do not move.
Food for one beat of my wings?
A corner of my wing folded. That hurts.
How do you not watch above you?

lines.zh: 萤石的光从我的翅纹里透出来。
lines.en: Glowstone light shows through my wing veins.
I am this big and you still hit me.
You scattered my wing scales.
Phosphor dust all over your face.
One bump and wing dust showers down.

lines.zh: 绯红森林里，我绕着菌伞飞。
lines.en: In the crimson forest I circle the fungi.
Make way. I am skimming low.
Neither of us watched the path.
My winglight is meant for you.
Follow me around the fungus cap.
Where are your wings? You have none.
I will shake a little dust over you.

lines.zh: 我翅上的光，是荧石蹭的。
lines.en: The glow on my wings came from glowstone.
Two lights drifting together. Lovely.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀会发光，你跟着。
lines.en: My wings glow — follow them.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀会发一点荧光。
lines.en: My wings give off a faint glow.
I will fly slow. Keep up.
Do not bump my wings. The dust comes off.

lines.zh: 这点光，我拿去垫我的巢。
lines.en: This glow will line my nest.
This bit of glowstone lasts a night.
I will fly with it pinched in my claws.
Heavy, but I can lift it.
This much light lasts me a night.
Anything bright goes to my nest.
If I drop it, I will come back for it.
I will hide it under the fungus cap.
This one will trade for a few seeds.

lines.zh: 绯红森林里，我像一团萤石。
lines.en: In the crimson forest, I look like glowstone.
The wind is right. I am coming down.

lines.zh: 从绯红林顶落下去最快。
lines.en: Dropping from the crimson canopy is fastest.

lines.zh: 绯红森林的光，跟我一起亮。
lines.en: The crimson glow lights with me.

lines.zh: 你在我正下方，运气不好。
lines.en: You are right below me. Bad luck.

lines.zh: 我的影子先落在你头顶。
lines.en: My shadow lands on your head first.

lines.zh: 小虫，趁荧光还亮快跑吧。
lines.en: Little bug, run while the glow lasts.
This glow will light you falling.
Wings folded. I have got you.
Do not run. The Nether has no long roads.

lines.zh: 绯红森林的萤石色，很招眼。
lines.en: Glowstone colors stand out in a crimson forest.

lines.zh: 在这片红光里，我比你快。
lines.en: In this red glow, I am faster.
The red glow helps me see you.

lines.zh: 你拐弯，我的翅也跟着拐。
lines.en: You turn, and my wings turn with you.

lines.zh: 你在下面拐弯了，我跟着。
lines.en: You turned below. I follow.
My wings do not tire. Your legs will.
Glowstone light clings to my wings.

lines.zh: 前面是岩浆，别怪我没说。
lines.en: Lava ahead. Do not say I did not warn you.
You run faster than I guessed.

lines.zh: 你跑到岩壁边就没路了。
lines.en: Run to the rock wall and you are done.

lines.zh: 下界里，我是会飞的那点光。
lines.en: In the Nether, I am the flying light.

lines.zh: 萤石粉沾在翅上，一拍就亮。
lines.en: Glowstone dust on my wings flares when I beat them.

lines.zh: 荧石翅膀擦过你的脖子。
lines.en: My glowstone wings grazed your neck.
The corners of my wings are sharp.

lines.zh: 绯红森林上空，我很显眼。
lines.en: Above the crimson forest, I stand out.
The wing edge rakes past. Enough.
My claws were never trimmed. Endure it.
One wingbeat and you tumble.
Phosphor dust in your eyes.

lines.zh: 萤石色的翅，撞上来很硬。
lines.en: Glowstone wings hit hard.
Hitting from above is easiest.

lines.zh: 这么暗的地方，我先亮起来。
lines.en: It's so dark here — I'll light up first.
Dark enough. Time to glow.
I light up out of the rock crack.

lines.zh: 有风从绯红森林来，能飞。
lines.en: Wind comes from the crimson forest; I can fly.
I settle on a nether fungus.
Too dark here. I will glow first.
Who put me in this red glow?
They call me Glowstone Morpho.
I land on the cap. Steady now.
My wings are still damp. Waiting for wind.
Hot! My dust is about to catch.
Wings cannot hold. I am going down.
Waterlogged wings sink fast.
The blast flung me aside.
A hole opened in my thin wing.
Light is crawling into my wing veins.
My winglight has gone dim with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，翅上的萤光灭了。
lines.en: Lightning struck; my wing-glow went out.
Falling. Where is the wind?
